## 2. Format templates for qualification / provenance-audit JSON

- Real exec004 artifact (placeholder, `status: NOT_RUN`): `ablation/analysis/post-audit-v2/evidence-revision-002-exec004-qualification.json` — schema `evidence-revision-002-exec004-qualification-v1`; fields: `calls: 0, calls_per_worker: 5, required_workers: 4`. (exec003 twin exists alongside.)

- No persisted real exec004 provenance-audit or `*authority*.json` exists anywhere on disk (only its hash, `provenance_audit_sha256: 9b3520b6676b…`, recorded inside the exec005 executable-contract lineage).

## 3. Run directories & naming convention

Root: `ablation/runs/<group>/<group>-<phase>-<YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>[-a<attempt>]>/`

- `evidence-revision-002-full-20260812T031030Z/` (attempt 001)
- `evidence-revision-002-full-20260812T092224Z-a002/` (attempt 002)

Prior-generation run dir shape (`ablation/runs/evidence-revision-001-revision-002/evidence-revision-001-revision-002-pilot-20260811T221724Z/`): `run.json`, `checkpoint.json`, `execution-summary.json`, `call-commits.jsonl`, `result-commits.jsonl`, `calls/<16-hex-id>/`, `raw/`, `results/`.

Older groups (same tree): `acq-pilot`, `acq-full/diagnostic-acquisition-001` (with `manifest.json`, `matrix.json`, `manifest.jsonl`, `raw/`, `scored/`, `acq_analysis.json`, `acq_report.json`), `attribution-001/-002`, `full-001`, `gov-pilot`, `gov-full`, `pilot-002`, `pilot-003`.

## 4. What defines COMPLETION of exec005

Note: **`docs/` is empty** — no files. The governing definitions are:

- `ablation/analysis/post-audit-v2/evidence-revision-002-successor-freeze-report.md` — "FULL matrix … Planned units: **430**"; "Analysis contract: canonical analysis verifies the exact **430-result set**, rejects orphan/duplicate result or raw-call ledgers, verifies runner/design/executable/matrix bindings …"; §Governed FULL transition completeness: "**completion requires a durable result commit and checkpoint state**" for every entry of the non-injectable loop.
- `.agents/CURRENT_STATUS.md` — "16-shard/4-worker, raw-before-score, ambiguity, and outcome-blind replacement behavior"; verification: 19 passed targeted + 472 passed suite; preflight PASS but `full_execution_authorized=false`.
- Scientific contract `ablation/analysis/post-audit-v2/evidence-revision-002-contract.json` — `full_plan.repetitions: 2` (so 430 = 215 coords × 2 reps, owner-directed); `primary_endpoint`: "the unit's FINAL diagnostic claim names the true locus"; `stop_condition`: owner §12 power-adjudication clause; `secondary_endpoints.revision_rate = EVALUATED_DERIVED_TYPED`, `matched_evidence_use = NOT_EVALUATED_UNDER_THIS_EXPERIMENT`.
- Shard math: 16 shards × ~27 units, frozen concurrency target 4 (`settlement.frozen_concurrency_target: 4` in the executable contract).

## 5. Operational-rules docs in ablation/

No README/AGENTS/protocol markdown in `ablation/` (only three analysis reports: `pilot-adjudication-revision-002.md`, `full-readiness-secondary-endpoint-audit-revision-002.md`, `evidence-revision-002-successor-freeze-report.md`; plus a small `RELEASE.gate` marker and shell drivers `run_governed_full.sh`, `run_parallel.sh`). The operational rules actually live in:

- `.agents/CURRENT_STATUS.md` → "Next authorization transition (not run)": after **commit/review**, a fresh synthetic exec005 qualification + matching provenance audit must pass; authority is minted only via `authorize-full --owner-authorized --qualification <fresh> --provenance-audit <fresh> --candidate-commit <reviewed-40-hex-commit> --output <authority.json>`; "FULL remains blocked absent that transition." "Safety boundary": zero live model/provider/qualification calls occurred; aborted run dirs untouched.
- Enforced in code/tests: candidate commit must be the checked-out HEAD (`test_stale_valid_candidate_commit_cannot_mint_authority`); release requires `runner_implementation_sha256` + `reviewed_runner_commit` (`.agents/reports/14-evidence-revision-runner-implementation-binding.md`); `test_qualification_bench_needs_explicit_intent_and_never_runs_here`.
- Sign-off: owner only (`--owner-authorized`; historical commit `86f77ad authorize(owner): release …`). No explicit dollar cost-cap document found; cost is implicitly bounded by frozen unit counts (430×2), qualification size (4 workers × 5 calls), and performed-call counters.

- `.agents/CURRENT_STATUS.md` (only status file; no `plans/` or `recovery/` dirs exist)
- `.agents/reports/`: `10-evidence-revision-runner-map.md`, `11-evidence-revision-runner-readiness.{md,json}`, `12-evidence-revision-validity-closure.{md,json}`, `13-evidence-revision-live-runner-repair.{md,json}`, `14-evidence-revision-runner-implementation-binding.{md,json}`, `15-evidence-revision-pilot-adjudication.json`
- `.agents/skills/jolli*/SKILL.md` (tooling skills, unrelated)

Exec003→005 chain: `d5083fa` exec003 parallel DeepSeek executor → `54467bd` exec004 OpenCode runtime transport → `24d459f` exec005 FULL authority gate → `fa1951f` test: bind ER002 exec005 authority fixtures to HEAD.

Earlier documented live-run sequence (freeze → authorize → run → aggregate):
- `5182a61` freeze: evidence-revision-001 scientific contract (NOT STARTED) / `17b4ef4` freeze: record owner state FROZEN_NOT_STARTED, execution not authorized
- `86f77ad` authorize(owner): release frozen evidence revision pilot only
- `a6f87d3` frozen orchestrator; `cf6b6ce` deterministic raw-bound resume state; `0ee6400` prove execution invariants; `60f599b` two-phase authorized pilot execution
- Pilot-era pattern: `1bf8067` M3 pilot manifest, blind selection, live run driver, preflight → `4bbaa89` acceptance gate + scoring/report (live 60-unit run) → `6f3a8e0` aggregate evidence + acceptance gate results → `d013e4f` full 720-run analysis + integrity gate

So the established per-transition rhythm is: freeze artifacts → commit → review → `authorize(owner)`/`authorize-full` commit → run-shards (raw+checkpoint durable commits) → aggregate/integrity-gate report commit.
